story-context.principle: Validate DefinitionJSON statically and deterministically so AI-generated forms can be corrected through structured feedback before UI rendering.

quality-posture.policy: Green CI/CD is mandatory at story closeout. No unresolved lint/test failures in touched scope.
quality-posture.anti-hallucination: If test output is truncated, timed out, or missing final summary, treat as failed and rerun.

in-scope.item: Validate schema correctness of DefinitionJSON payload
Validate canvas boundary constraints for components
Return machine-readable errors suitable for AI retry loops
Add automated tests for pass/fail scenarios

out-of-scope.item: AI model integration and retry orchestration

done-criteria.dc: Endpoint exists and responds with expected contract
Valid payload returns valid=true with no errors
Green CI/CD evidence attached to story closeout

story-context.reuse-guidance: Reuse existing schema and collision logic concepts from current codebase to avoid rule drift between builder/runtime and validator.
